objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the Struts 1 integration page evaluate an OGNL expression, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Open the Struts 1 integration example (Save Gangster) and see what it does with the name you give it. Read the S2-048 advisory.

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the component
steps.prompt: Which Struts2 plugin is vulnerable? (plugin name)

steps.prompt: Which expression language evaluates the action message? (acronym)
